# GovInfo provider inputs

`fr-2026-01-02.xml` is the unchanged public Federal Register issue downloaded from
https://www.govinfo.gov/bulkdata/FR/2026/01/FR-2026-01-02.xml on 2026-11-09.
It is a U.S. federal government publication. SHA-256:
`6b73122beef5911a596b186c953ab69f846ed2111db0c887a6b4451375d8fcf3`.
The complete issue tests original-byte downloads followed by XML decoding.

`issue-catalog.json` is a project-authored minimal bulk-directory response selecting
that issue. Other JSON samples in this directory are project-authored provider
contract examples, including invalid identities and retained unknown fields.
